findings.evidence: _encryptionHelper.encrypt(...) was called inside a try block whose catch clauses only handled ApiException subtypes; a crypto exception would propagate uncaught, aborting _flush's loop for every other pending row.
findings.why_it_matters: Phase file Design Constraint requires encryption failures to surface as a clear error through the existing sync/retry path, never a silent fallback or an unhandled crash.
findings.required_action: Isolate the encrypt() call's failure surface from the network-error catch chain.
findings.fix_description: Extracted a private _encryptAnswer(answer, publicKey) helper wrapping encrypt() in its own try/catch; on failure it logs, marks the row terminal-rejected (ENCRYPTION_FAILED), and returns null so _flushOne returns early without falling through to either network call. Re-verified present and correctly wired, no new issues introduced, flutter analyze and full test suite pass.
